At.description: A UTC time to the millisecond, such as 2026-11-17T15:04:05.123Z.

By.description:
Who wrote an entry, and through which face. An audit label, never authentication: nothing
is refused for who wrote it.

face.description: The face they acted through: `cli`, later `server`, `app` or `mcp`.

EntryFrame.description:
One entry as `journal` 1.0 frames it, its body unread: what the committed schema's
`$defs/Record` describes. A reader reads the body by its event kind ([`read_line`]).

cause.description: The entry that caused it, if one did.

v.description: The event kind's version the body is written at.

JournalHead.description:
`journal` 1.0's first line holds the head: the project's name, the segment's own id, and its
stamp, so a segment read alone still says which it is.

id.description: This segment's id, as the index line that opens it names it.

project.description: The name of the project whose journal this is.

segment.description: This segment's stamp, as its file name gives it.

SegmentStamp.description: A segment's first moment, UTC to the millisecond in ISO 8601 basic form, such as 20261117T150405123Z. Its file is journal.<stamp>.duet.jsonl.

Version.description: A kind's schema version, <major>.<minor>, such as 1.0.

description: The first line of a .duet.jsonl stream of kind journal, at schema version 1.0.
title: duet journal 1.0
